summary: Ticketed seasonal ceremony ('Winter Solstice Earth Devotion Gathering') held at Herb Mountain Farm in Weaverville, NC, led by a single named individual, Mary Plantwalker, featuring an herbal tea ceremony, wild-edibles ID, and craft-making. The listings and organizer page show no group name, no membership language, and no social/community links; it reads as a solo practitioner's paid seasonal offering rather than a club with a fixed, returning membership.

evidence.note: Description is workshop-style ('nourish your wild heart with an herbal tea ceremony, ID'ing edibles, making craft') with no mention of members, a group name, dues, or a community to join.

Second listing reuses the identical 'Winter Solstice' title but is dated 2025-04-19, months off-season; both are attributed to the same sole organizer and venue with no distinguishing community identity.
Fetched the listing directly: no 'about the organizer' bio, no links to a Facebook group, Meetup, Discord, or newsletter were present.

Multiple search attempts for "Mary Plantwalker" (Bing, DuckDuckGo, an Eventbrite organizer-URL guess) returned no results tied to this person; search engines either returned irrelevant hits or blocked automated access, so no independent website or social presence could be confirmed either way.
